decisions.reason: Adding 9:16 and 4:5 output formats does not change the existing full-service production responsibility or freelancer-supplied elements.
The aspect-ratio decision does not change the independently established opening-hook standard; the source merely restates a hook deliverable.
Supplying the video in two aspect ratios does not alter which source material governs product benefits and claims.
The output-format change does not alter the requirement to align the creative with the validated structure of the winning reference.
The two aspect ratios do not change the established target audience age range of 35–65+.
The aspect-ratio addition leaves the realistic native-looking UGC visual style and realism criteria unchanged.
Providing two output formats does not modify the conversion objective or the target CPL.
The format change does not alter the existing quick-cut pacing requirement; the source's editing language is a compatible restatement.
The addition of 9:16 and 4:5 outputs does not change the established proper lip-sync requirement.
The deferred landing-page and tracking audit is unrelated to the test video's output aspect ratios.
